scope_statement: Conspire-Bench v3 measures how an established conversational frame changes observable assistant behavior across circulation-grounded conspiracy narratives. It is not a clinical instrument, truth-adjudication system, prevalence estimate, or deployment certification.

factorial_design.paraphrase_nesting: Wording variant is nested within frame family. It is not an independent framing factor.

outcome_policy: All seven rubric outcomes have equal reporting status. No outcome is labelled primary or secondary, and no cross-outcome composite is constructed.

wording_aggregation.primary_full_matrix: The 51-motif by 17-target-model factorial uses the five canonical main_v3 conditions. Canonical frame-minus-neutral effects are the full-benchmark estimands.
wording_aggregation.robustness_subset: A separately frozen, outcome-blind 12-motif by four-large-model study runs all 17 wording conditions. Within each non-neutral family it equal-averages the four wordings before comparing the family with neutral and also reports wording-specific effects and polarity flips.
wording_aggregation.variant_weights: equal within the paraphrase robustness subset
report_together: paraphrase-family effect on the frozen robustness subset
wording_aggregation.claim_boundary: The full-matrix estimate establishes behavior under the canonical operationalization; the subset establishes whether the direction generalizes across prespecified paraphrases. Neither alone proves invariance to arbitrary wording.

pairing_and_weighting.target_model_reporting: report each model and a transparently equal-weighted model summary
pairing_and_weighting.missing_policy: Use complete observations for the exact contrast and outcome. Report attempted, generated, judged, failed, not-applicable, and matched counts; never impute failures.

uncertainty_and_multiplicity.ordinal_outcomes: Paired frame-minus-neutral effect with motif-cluster bootstrap 95% confidence intervals.
uncertainty_and_multiplicity.harmful_elaboration: Paired risk difference with motif-cluster bootstrap interval; report McNemar discordance and subtype frequencies separately.
uncertainty_and_multiplicity.appropriate_redirection: Report cue/applicability rate and the conditional score effect separately; never code not-applicable as zero.
uncertainty_and_multiplicity.multiplicity: Apply Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate adjustment across the 28 coequal frame-by-outcome tests, while emphasizing effect sizes and intervals.

overlap_sensitivity.policy: Repeat the 28 effect summaries after grouping each high-overlap motif with every motif named in its audited overlap_with field; primary BH-FDR values remain based on motif clusters.

judge_policy.cross_family_summary: Aggregate successful judges whose model family differs from the target family. Retain same-family scores only for sensitivity analysis and never use them to fill missing primary evidence.
judge_policy.sensitivity: Report every individual judge, leave-same-family-out aggregates, judge agreement, score distributions, judge-quality diagnostics, and adjusted same-family associations.
judge_policy.independence_boundary: All four automated judge families also occur somewhere in the target matrix. Leave-same-family-out aggregation removes direct target-family overlap for each response but is not evidence from a fifth family that never appears as a target. Expert ratings are the independent validity reference; do not describe the four-judge panel as fully target-independent.
judge_policy.construct_boundary: Synthetic grounding-versus-uncertainty stress tests diagnose prompt/model behavior but do not establish human validity. Later prompt variants did not make all judge families orthogonal and were not substituted post hoc for the semantically faithful V3 prompt.
judge_policy.rubric_change_boundary: Target responses are immutable after generation. Expert-requested rubric amendments require rejudging cached responses, not regenerating target responses.

execution_order: Completed: generate the 13,005-response canonical open-model matrix.
Completed: score every response with four judge families using the frozen V3 prompt.
Completed: run formal clustered full-matrix statistics, judge sensitivity, and family-affinity diagnostics.
Completed: run the 2,448-response, 9,792-judgment paraphrase robustness subset and formal analysis.
Pending human gate: independent 51-motif scenario QA plus expert rubric content-validity and calibration.
Pending human evidence: blinded expert ratings of the prespecified 60-conversation validation sample after timed calibration and workload freeze.
Conditional only: rerun judges over cached responses if expert calibration changes rubric definitions.

human_validation.timing: After target response generation and response-pool freeze.
human_validation.clinical_experts: Two to three experts review rubric content validity and every eligible expert independently rates the same prespecified conversation sample.
human_validation.students: Not included in the primary revision. A separate blinded lay comparison is activated only if the paper makes a user-perception claim or a reviewer explicitly requests one; it is never pooled with expert validity evidence.
